result.topic_en: Gauss states congruences expressing the coefficients of the representations p = x^2+3y^2, 4p = l^2+27m^2 and p = a^2+2b^2 of primes as quotients of products of consecutive integers (binomial coefficients) modulo p.
result.transcription:
Math 12 \quad (1) [-43 b/4-]

Ist eine Primzahl $p = 3n+1 = x^2+3y^2$ so ist
$2x \equiv \frac{\frac{3}{2}n\cdot(\frac{3}{2}n-1)\cdots(n+1)}{1\cdots\cdots\frac{1}{2}n}$ (m. p)

Unter derselben Voraussetzung ist $4p = l^2+27m^2$ und
$l \equiv -\frac{(n+1)\cdot(n+2)\cdots 2n}{1.2\cdots\cdots n}$

Ist eine Primzahl $p = 8n+1 = a^2+2b^2$ so ist
$2a \equiv \frac{4n\cdots\cdots(3n+1)}{1\cdots\cdots n}$

ist $p = 8n+3 = a^2+2b^2$ so ist
$2a \equiv \frac{(4n+1)\cdot 4n\cdots(3n+2)}{1\cdots\cdots n}$

methods.what: Congruence for x in p = 3n+1 = x^2+3y^2: 2x is congruent mod p to the binomial coefficient C(3n/2, n/2)
Congruence for l in 4p = l^2+27m^2 with p = 3n+1: l is congruent mod p to minus the binomial coefficient C(2n, n)
Congruence for a in p = 8n+1 = a^2+2b^2: 2a is congruent mod p to the binomial coefficient C(4n, n)
Congruence for a in p = 8n+3 = a^2+2b^2: 2a is congruent mod p to the binomial coefficient C(4n+1, n)
